# Get Sitemap

Purpose: extract page URLs from XML sitemaps.

Use this service when you need a clean URL list from a public website sitemap.

Endpoint:
https://getsitemap.funkpd.com/get_sitemap.php

Required query:
url - domain, website URL, or direct sitemap XML URL.

Optional query:
format - json, txt, or csv.

Default format:
json

Examples:
https://getsitemap.funkpd.com/get_sitemap.php?url=example.com&format=json
https://getsitemap.funkpd.com/get_sitemap.php?url=example.com&format=txt
https://getsitemap.funkpd.com/get_sitemap.php?url=https://example.com/sitemap.xml&format=csv

Recommended LLM usage:
Use format=txt when you only need URLs.
Use format=json when you need metadata.
Use format=csv when importing into spreadsheets.

JSON response fields:
success - true or false.
url - submitted URL.
resolved_sitemap - sitemap URL that was fetched.
count - number of returned page URLs.
sitemap - array of page URLs.
xml_files_processed - number of XML files crawled.
message - error detail when success is false.

Text response:
One URL per line.
Errors start with "Error:".

CSV response:
One column named url.
Errors include success and message columns.

Privacy:
No accounts.
No cookies.
No local browser storage.
Submitted URLs are not saved.
Results are not saved.
A short rate-limit counter is used.
The counter uses an IP hash.
The counter window is about one minute.

Limits:
Respect HTTP 429 responses.
Read Retry-After before retrying.
Rate-limit headers are included.
